definitions.gloss: productization; developing into a marketable product
definitions.explanation: Taking a technology, prototype, or idea and turning it into something that can actually be manufactured and sold. Used with する as a verb.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{製品化|せいひんか}⟦されていない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This technology has not been turned into a product yet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試作品|しさくひん}→試作品：22445_shisakuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{製品化|せいひんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took three years to turn the prototype into a product.

examples.japanese: ⟦{研究所|けんきゅうじょ}→研究所：19075_kenkyuujo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{製品化|せいひんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦コスト→コスト：06666_kosuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: To turn the laboratory's results into a product, the cost problem has to be solved.

notes:
⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧ (manufactured product) + ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (the suffix for turning into). Belongs to the large family of ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ nouns that take ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, like ⟦{実用化|じつようか}→実用化：29779_jitsuyouka⟧ and ⟦{商品化|しょうひんか}→商品化：30135_shouhinka⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {製品化|せいひんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to turn into a product
- {製品化|せいひんか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧: for productization to be decided on
- {製品化|せいひんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目処|めど}が{立|た}つ→目処が立つ：16120_medogatatsu⟧: for the path to a product to become clear

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{商品化|しょうひんか}→商品化：30135_shouhinka⟧: commercialization — emphasizes putting it on sale rather than manufacturing it
- ⟦{実用化|じつようか}→実用化：29779_jitsuyouka⟧: putting to practical use — the technology works in the field, whether or not it is sold
